\subsection{Statistical Summary for scenario 2: Standard build workflow benchmarks}

% Legend explaining metrics
{\footnotesize
\noindent\textbf{Metrics:} 
Wall Time = benchmark execution time (seconds); 
Sys CPU $\Delta$ = system CPU increase from baseline (\%); 
Sys Mem $\Delta$ Peak = peak system memory increase from baseline (MB); 
Baseline = idle system state before benchmark; 
Host Mem Peak = hypervisor process peak memory (for VM environments only).
}

% Legend for shortened environment names
{\footnotesize
\noindent\textbf{Environment Names:}
\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
\item Hyper-V Windows 11 Guest = Hyper-V / Windows 11 Guest
\item Hyper-V Debian 12 Guest = Hyper-V / Debian 12 Guest
\item Docker Desktop Win11 Debian... = Docker Desktop Win11 / Debian 12 container / volume-mounted
\item Docker Linux Debian 12 (both) = Docker Linux / Debian 12 (both)
\end{itemize}
}
